findings.text: follow-on: cf12c1653 deletes tests/test_context_budget.py, which the node's declared write paths do not enumerate, so the change writes outside its fenced scope; the deletion is authorized by the plan's own §3 write paths ("the test files whose only subject is a deleted module") and is required by the done-when's no-hit grep, so it does not hold the node, but the dispatch fence under-enumerated the scope and should have named it.

follow-on: the manifest records its gate observation as a prose tests/test_logs line and carries no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so annotate_review_of_run resolves no base or head gate log for this run and yields an unmeasured added-failure count; the count was recoverable here by running the reviewed run's own gate command at its base 25b07c0 (15 passed, EXIT=0) as the base arm against the reviewed gate log at cf12c1653 (13 passed, EXIT=0) as the head arm, giving zero added failures, but a reader on the production path sees it null.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 25b07c0; cf12c1653 deletes the module and its dedicated test, reverts the context_budget import and removes the two refusal-census test functions from tests/test_routing_surface.py, drops the allowlist entry and the docstring reference in reckon/crew/routing.py:3532, and d8e9fc2bc adds the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when has four clauses; `grep -rn context_budget reckon/ tests/ skills/` at head d8e9fc2bc returns no hit (EXIT=1, run by this review), the reviewed gate log gate-context-budget-deleted.log records tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py and tests/test_routing_surface.py at 13 passed with EXIT=0 at cf12c1653, the allowlist in tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py:29 no longer carries reckon.crew.context_budget, and the negative control negative-control-context-budget-deleted.log fails tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py::test_every_module_is_reached by name (reckon.crew.context_budget: unreached and not in the allowlist) with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to delete the unreached context-budget module with its tests; commit cf12c1653 deletes reckon/crew/context_budget.py (230 lines) and tests/test_context_budget.py (112 lines), and drops the two refusal-census tests that were the module's only exercises from tests/test_routing_surface.py:698-771, so the module and the tests that exist only to test it are gone.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits cf12c1653 and d8e9fc2bc, the tests line names the focused gate (13 passed, EXIT=0 at cf12c1653) with test_logs naming the gate and negative-control logs, and its follow_ons already flag that tests/test_context_budget.py lay outside the enumerated dispatch scope; it declares no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so the production annotation path reads an unmeasured added-failure count.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six paths; the diff touches five of them (reckon/crew/context_budget.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_routing_surface.py, tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py, docs/evidence/fragments/nothing-lands-unreached/context-budget-deleted.html) and additionally deletes tests/test_context_budget.py, which the declared list omits; the declared figure path docs/figures/nothing-lands-unreached/context-budget-deleted was not written.

justifications.durability: the change is a deletion, and its guard is the reach ratchet at tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py:61, which the reviewed run's negative control proves fires on this exact regression by failing tests/test_every_module_is_reached.py:64 when reckon.crew.context_budget is restored unreached; the guard pre-exists the node rather than being added by it.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's gate is the reviewed run's own gate-context-budget-deleted.log (13 passed, EXIT=0 at cf12c1653) and its negative control fails the ratchet by name (EXIT=1), both on disk and both re-read here; the manifest records the result rather than claiming it, but declares no baseline_suite/after_suite pair, so a reader on the production annotation path sees the added-failure count as unmeasured.
justifications.fit: both commits carry a conventional subject and a body, no plan label or ticket id appears in a symbol, filename or comment of the touched source, and the evidence fragment follows the docs/evidence/fragments layout of its siblings (`docs/evidence/fragments/nothing-lands-unreached/context-budget-deleted.html`).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/context_budget.py and tests/test_context_budget.py are deleted in cf12c1653 and no reference survives under reckon/, tests/ or skills/, which is exactly the goal.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition and no capability, so nothing is forked; the one surviving artifact it names, docs/research/data/clive-effective-window.json, is left in place and remains reproducible.
justifications.scope_discipline: tests/test_context_budget.py:1 is deleted by cf12c1653 but is absent from the node's declared write paths, and the declared figure path docs/figures/nothing-lands-unreached is unused, so the diff leaves the enumerated scope even though the plan's own §3 write paths authorize deleting test files whose only subject is a deleted module.
